CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sellerpilot_private.local_channel_executor_access(p_channel text, p_operation text)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select case
    when p_operation in ('diagnostic.test','orders.list','inquiries.list') and p_channel in ('coupang','smartstore','elevenst','temu','shopee','lazada','qoo10','ebay') then 'read'
    when p_channel = 'coupang' and p_operation in ('categories.attributes','categories.validate','listing.publication.verify') then 'read'
    when p_operation = 'listing.create' and p_channel in ('coupang','smartstore','elevenst','temu','shopee','lazada','qoo10','ebay') then 'write'
    when p_channel in ('smartstore','qoo10') and p_operation = 'listing.update' then 'write'
    else null end
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION sellerpilot_private.local_channel_executor_read_bootstrap_allowed(p_job_id uuid, p_credential_id uuid, p_worker_token_id uuid, p_worker_version text, p_release_sha text, p_egress_ip_sha256 text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  select coalesce((
    select
      job.status = 'queued'
      and job.operation in ('diagnostic.test', 'orders.list', 'inquiries.list')
      and sellerpilot_private.local_channel_executor_access(
        job.channel, job.operation) = 'read'
      and coalesce(p_release_sha, '') ~ '^[a-f0-9]{40}$'
      and coalesce(p_egress_ip_sha256, '') ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'
      and coalesce(p_worker_version, '') =
        'sellerpilot-cli-worker/1.61+' || p_release_sha || '.' ||
        left(p_egress_ip_sha256, 11)
      and sellerpilot_private.active_serverless_runtime_release_sha() =
        p_release_sha
      and exists (
        select 1
          from sellerpilot_private.local_channel_executor_routes route
          join sellerpilot_private.channel_credentials credential
            on credential.id = route.credential_id
         where route.channel = job.channel
           and route.operation = job.operation
           and route.credential_id = p_credential_id
           and route.worker_token_id = p_worker_token_id
           and route.enabled is true
           and route.approved_by is not null
           and route.approved_at is not null
           and (route.expires_at is null
                or route.expires_at > clock_timestamp())
           and route.release_sha = p_release_sha
           and route.egress_ip_sha256 = p_egress_ip_sha256
           and credential.channel = route.channel
           and credential.environment = 'production'
           and credential.status = 'active'
           and (credential.expires_at is null
                or credential.expires_at > clock_timestamp())
           and credential.seller_account_key = route.seller_account_key
      )
      from sellerpilot_private.channel_gateway_jobs job
     where job.id = p_job_id
       and job.credential_id = p_credential_id
  ), false)
$function$

constraint.definition: CHECK ((((channel = 'coupang'::text) AND (operation = ANY (ARRAY['categories.attributes'::text, 'categories.validate'::text, 'listing.create'::text, 'listing.publication.verify'::text, 'orders.list'::text, 'inquiries.list'::text, 'diagnostic.test'::text]))) OR ((channel = 'smartstore'::text) AND (operation = ANY (ARRAY['listing.create'::text, 'listing.update'::text, 'orders.list'::text, 'inquiries.list'::text, 'diagnostic.test'::text]))) OR ((channel = ANY (ARRAY['elevenst'::text, 'temu'::text, 'shopee'::text, 'lazada'::text, 'ebay'::text])) AND (operation = ANY (ARRAY['listing.create'::text, 'orders.list'::text, 'inquiries.list'::text, 'diagnostic.test'::text]))) OR ((channel = 'qoo10'::text) AND (operation = ANY (ARRAY['listing.create'::text, 'listing.update'::text, 'orders.list'::text, 'inquiries.list'::text, 'diagnostic.test'::text])))))
